clues.kinetics: Absolute oral bioavailability is 95%, and food does not significantly change exposure. It is over 99% bound to plasma protein and is cleared mainly through metabolism by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6.
clues.substance: Molecular weight 433.6. Inactive ingredients include lactose monohydrate and corn starch.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA in six strengths, from 0.25 mg to 4 mg, dosed once daily.
clues.safety: Boxed warning on increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia, and on suicidal thoughts. Contraindicated with known hypersensitivity; weight gain and akathisia are common.
clues.indication: Adjunctive treatment of major depressive disorder in adults, schizophrenia in patients 13 years and older, and agitation linked to dementia from Alzheimer's disease.
clues.mechanism: Its efficacy may come from a combination of partial agonist activity at serotonin and dopamine receptors and antagonist activity at serotonin receptors; the exact mechanism is unknown.

tell: Its major metabolite, DM-3411, reaches 23% to 48% of parent exposure at steady state.
